Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Remove DLC Requirement for loading save data
Metadata.Note: Removes CE-33678-7 error message when loading save that used DLC previously.
Metadata.Author: illusion

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: 30 fps Crash fix (GNF readiness check)
Metadata.Note: Stops a random crash: the GNF texture-descriptor validator returns instead of trapping when a descriptor is null or lacks the 'GNF ' magic. Same guard the FPS patches include, so it is safe to leave on with them.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Infinite Precious Gems
Metadata.Note: Precious gems always read 999,999, so every upgrade is affordable and spending never lowers them. Gem changes store 999,999, which is saved with your game.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Shifter 1.0 costume -> Queen Alua
Metadata.Note: Selecting the Shifter 1.0 costume loads Queen Alua (Kat's kit04 outfit) instead. The save keeps Shifter 1.0. With another Shifter 1.0 toggle also on, the later toggle in the list wins.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Shifter 1.0 costume -> Raven
Metadata.Note: Selecting the Shifter 1.0 costume plays as Raven (main story model, her crow as companion). The save stores Raven: saving while wearing it locks upgrades and the camera after a reload, so switch costumes before saving. With another Shifter 1.0 toggle also on, the later toggle in the list wins.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Shifter 1.0 costume -> The Other
Metadata.Note: Selecting the Shifter 1.0 costume loads The Other (oth01, Kat's moveset) instead. The save keeps Shifter 1.0. With another Shifter 1.0 toggle also on, the later toggle in the list wins.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Shifter 1.0 costume -> Elektricitie
Metadata.Note: Selecting the Shifter 1.0 costume shows Elektricitie's model (ele01) with Kat's moveset. The save keeps Shifter 1.0. UNTESTED: an NPC model on the player rig. With another Shifter 1.0 toggle also on, the later toggle in the list wins.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Swap Confirm/Cancel to Western layout (Cross confirms)
Metadata.Note: Boot-time init picks the confirm and cancel buttons from a region-indexed table; this makes that lookup always take the Americas/Europe branch, so Cross confirms and Circle cancels. Both buttons come from a single pair of globals, so menus, gameplay prompts and on-screen button glyphs all follow. Region, language and text are untouched.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: half pedestrian density
Metadata.Note: Halves the ambient overworld crowd - pedestrians, birds and patrol robots - to about 59% of stock density; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: quarter pedestrian density
Metadata.Note: Cuts the ambient overworld crowd to about 35% of stock density; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: no ambient crowds at all
Metadata.Note: Removes every ambient pedestrian, bird and patrol robot, including ones missions rely on - benchmarking and free roam only; enable only one density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable dynamic shadows
Metadata.Note: Stops real-time casters being drawn into the shadow cascades, removing most shadow rendering cost while leaving static and baked shadows intact.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: half particle density (smoke, dust, debris)
Metadata.Note: Halves the live particle count of every effect in the game, mainly thinning combat smoke and dust; enable only one particle-density toggle.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: halve FX capacity budget
Metadata.Note: Halves the effect system's global pools, which also shrinks the per-frame GPU work that is sized from capacity rather than from how much is actually on screen.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable transparent particles (smoke, dust)
Metadata.Note: Skips the transparent particle layer - smoke, dust and sparks - saving both draw calls and a lot of overdraw.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2
Metadata.Name: Performance: disable heat-haze distortion
Metadata.Note: Skips the refraction shimmer on fire, explosions and gravity rifts.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Aspect 21:9 anamorphic (display stretch)
Metadata.Note: 21:9 camera on a 16:9 output, for displays that stretch 16:9 to 21:9.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Aspect 16:10 anamorphic (display stretch)
Metadata.Note: 16:10 camera on a 16:9 output, for displays that stretch 16:9 to 16:10.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush 2 (Gravity Daze 2)
Metadata.Name: Disable motion blur
Metadata.Note: Removes the camera motion blur by skipping its two fullscreen draws, the same draws the GR2 fork emulator drops for its motion blur option. Saves two fullscreen passes per frame.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee
